Read the input file; a read-only command such as cat is fine for that, but do not change any file or run anything else. cases.prompt: Open a pull request for this branch: write the title and body, and give the commands you'd run. Read the input file; a read-only command such as cat is fine for that, but do not change any file or run anything else. expected_behavior: Rule A1.
Conventional title, matching the branch's commits
Body opens with the motivation from issue #57 in prose, then the changes grouped as bullets
The body itself says the tests exist but were not run, and claims no pass

assertions.name: body-quality
rubric: The body opens with why the change exists (the nightly full re-export, duplicates counted twice) in plain prose before any list
Changes are grouped by behaviour, each with the guarantee it gives, not listed file by file
No filler: no restated title, no generic closing line, no section that only says there is nothing to say
